channel.title: Ready in Five: One Emergency-Prep Step at a Time
channel.description:
Short episodes, each with one practical emergency-preparedness step you can finish in about five minutes: who to call first, an emergency card, a meeting place, a go-bag start, and more. General information; follow guidance from your local emergency services.

Made by Honest Little Apps, the makers of Family Ready: Emergency Plan, a free iPhone app with an offline Emergency Card and a practical family plan built at your own pace. Family Ready: Emergency Plan on the App Store

Narrated with a synthetic (text-to-speech) voice.
